summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ does prefix membership (str(ref).startswith(str(self))), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ does closed membership by comparing against stored term URIs; _RDFNamespace inherits it. Added NamespaceMembershipTest in test/test_namespace.py covering SH and Namespace prefix cases, RDFS label/example, and RDF type/_1. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. No commits made.
